newsitem.title: USA: Harken Energy to close $70 m cnv note sale.
newsitem.headline: Harken Energy to close $70 m cnv note sale.

text.p: Harken Energy Corp said Friday it intends to close the sale of $70 million in convertible notes in Europe on June 11.

The notes bear 5.5 percent interest until maturity in the year 2002, unless earlier redeemed or converted. They are convertible under certain conditions into shares of Harken common stock at a conversion price of $5.00 per share based on pricing set on June 3. The notes have not been registered and cannot be offered or sold in the U.S.

"With the expanded capital base provided through this offering we plan to develop the prospects identified through our recent Colombian discoveries and to keep larger prospects in selected future prospects," said Harken's chairman Mikel Faulkner in a statement.
Harken said in March it planned to spend $30 million to drill four exploration fields in Colombia and continue developing the Rio Negro field there.
